_doc: S79 B3-A copy fixture (spec 4.1 / 4.2, rulings A8 + A13). Every AR string is a draft for the owner's NATIVE READ. AR values carry no harakat, shadda or tanween except inside the brand word (ruling A8). The learning_keys copy (ruling A13) was drafted by the RED agent: the spec gives none; GREEN and the owner may reword it, the fixture is the contract.

en.NSCameraUsageDescription: MYEZ uses the camera to photograph the two products you want to compare. The photos are uploaded to MYEZ's servers and sent to OpenAI to identify the products.
en.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: MYEZ opens your photo library only for the photos you pick. Those photos are uploaded to MYEZ's servers and sent to OpenAI to identify the products.
